hard_requirements.real_browser_workload: No process whose executable is the actual Google Chrome or Safari browser binary. Browser helpers/extensions remain visible but do not satisfy this identity rule by substring alone.
hard_requirements.model_index_service_identity: Must match the separately frozen benchmark provenance.

cpu_interference_rule.sampling: Continuous one-second samples from the end of preflight settling through final benchmark artifact closure.
cpu_interference_rule.identity: Stable process group is category plus canonical executable path plus nearest identified application/service ancestor; PID is evidence, not the stable key.
cpu_interference_rule.aggregation: Sum CPU percent for CPU-scored processes sharing the stable group key within each sample.
cpu_interference_rule.violation: The same CPU-scored stable process group is at or above 50 percent for 10 consecutive samples.
cpu_interference_rule.reset: The group's streak resets to zero whenever the group is absent or below 50 percent.
cpu_interference_rule.action: Invalidate the run at the first qualifying streak; preserve the triggering samples and process identities.

process_categories.service_host_boundary: Only directly evidenced service hosts are excluded. Docker Desktop UI/renderers, ChatGPT, and Codex do not inherit an application-wide exemption.
process_categories.unknown_rule: Unknown processes remain visible and CPU-scored.

validation_result.short_bursts: 0 invalidation episodes across six 1.5-second controlled bursts
validation_result.browser: Detected by the independent hard rule in the first sampled browser interval

limitations: The clean calibration covers 33 minutes across three scenarios, not a full multi-hour 60-case run or an hour-scale statistical upper bound.
The supervised-idle maximum same-group streak was nine samples, one below the selected boundary.
Calibration does not establish that CPU interference caused any historical analyst timeout.
Terminal-only control monitoring is demonstrated; terminal-only semantic case execution was intentionally not run.
This contract does not modify or retroactively validate any historical artifact.

publication_privacy.rule: User-home prefixes and email addresses in captured process command lines are replaced with $USER_HOME and $EMAIL.
publication_privacy.semantic_effect: None; publication sanitization changes string evidence and file hashes only, before the artifact freeze.
